title: Happy butterfly
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="38" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#ff6fb5" transform="rotate(-20 30 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="38" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#ff6fb5" transform="rotate(20 70 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="62" rx="17" ry="14" fill="#ffb84d" transform="rotate(15 32 62)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="62" rx="17" ry="14" fill="#ffb84d" transform="rotate(-15 68 62)"/>

  <!-- wing spots -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="36" r="6" fill="#ffe36e"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="36" r="6" fill="#ffe36e"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="62" r="4" fill="#ff6fb5"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="62" r="4" fill="#ff6fb5"/>

  <!-- wing edges -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="38" rx="22" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#ff9ed2" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(-20 30 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="38" rx="22" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#ff9ed2" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(20 70 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="62" rx="17" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#ffcf80" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(15 32 62)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="62" rx="17" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#ffcf80" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(-15 68 62)"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="5" ry="22" fill="#7b5cff"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="5" ry="22" fill="none" stroke="#b39bff" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="27" r="7" fill="#7b5cff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="27" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#b39bff" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d="M47 21 Q42 12 37 10" fill="none" stroke="#b39bff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M53 21 Q58 12 63 10" fill="none" stroke="#b39bff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="37" cy="10" r="2.5" fill="#ffe36e"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="10" r="2.5" fill="#ffe36e"/>

  <!-- happy eyes -->
  <path d="M46 26 Q47.5 24 49 26" fill="none" stroke="#ffe36e" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M51 26 Q52.5 24 54 26" fill="none" stroke="#ffe36e" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M47 30 Q50 33 53 30" fill="none" stroke="#ffe36e" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
